agentAnswers.prompt: Which properties in Lake County within five miles of Clermont have roofs older than 15 years?

ASSISTANT · GPT-5-MINI
Short answer
- I found 17,150 Lake County parcels within 5 miles of Clermont whose properties have properties.roof_age_years > 15 in this run. Evidence: I used the properties table columns request_identifier (parcel id), address_street, address_city, address_zip, latitude, longitude, roof_age_years and roof_age_basis from the properties view (source: FL DOR NAL 2026P) joined to the FL GIO parcel centroids 2025 coordinates; the spatial center for "Clermont" came from resolveCityCentre. The dataset run id / selected as-of snapshot is 20260916T181000Z.

What I ran and where the numbers came from
- I ran a spatial query against the properties view (columns used: request_identifier, address_street, address_city, address_zip, latitude, longitude, roof_age_years, roof_age_basis) joined to the FL GIO parcel centroids 2025 coordinates and filtered by ST_Distance from the Clermont center (resolveCityCentre for "Clermont", radius 5 miles). The properties table source is FL DOR NAL 2026P; coordinates source is FL GIO parcel centroids 2025. The selected dataset snapshot is runId 20260916T181000Z (dataset.getDatasetInfo).

Important data limitations and provenance (evidence)
- roof_age_years is derived by the pipeline and the per-parcel roof_age_basis value is included in the results (column: roof_age_basis). The dataset metadata warns roof age uses valid actual building year as a LOW-confidence proxy and that a building-year proxy is not the same as a measured roof replacement (see the coverage/limitations text returned by dataset.getDatasetInfo in this run). In short: a roof_age_years > 15 in this table can mean the structure’s year-built is older than 15 years, not that a recorded roof replacement was observed.
- Coordinates come from the FL GIO parcel centroids 2025 release matched by ALT_KEY; properties lacking coordinates could be omitted. The spatial center for "Clermont" (used to define the 5-mile radius) came from resolveCityCentre (center lat 28.54612, lon -81.74960).
- Permit or contractor evidence was not used to reset roof age; completion/issued permit text is not automatically accepted as proof of a finished roof replacement in this snapshot.

Next steps I can take
- Export the full list of all 17,150 parcel ids and their columns to CSV / copy-paste for you.
- Filter this set further (e.g., only residential parcels, or only properties with roofing permits present) — say which filter you want and I’ll run it.

Evidence summary (explicit)
- Query results: runSql rows (properties.request_identifier, address_street, address_city, address_zip, latitude, longitude, roof_age_years, roof_age_basis) — source: properties (FL DOR NAL 2026P) joined to coordinates (FL GIO parcel centroids 2025). Spatial center: resolveCityCentre("Clermont") output (center lat/lon and parcelsWithCoordinates = 48303). Dataset snapshot: getDatasetInfo runId 20260916T181000Z; limitations text about roof_age proxy included there.

agentAnswers.prompt: Which properties near that area have open roofing permits that have been open for many years, and who is the listed contractor?
agentAnswers.observedText:
ASSISTANT · GPT-5-MINI
I can do that — I just need one clarification: what do you mean by "many years" open?

Options I can run now (pick one):
- > 365 days (open more than 1 year)
- > 1,095 days (open more than 3 years)
- Or give a specific number of days or years you prefer.

I'll return parcel id (properties.request_identifier), address (address_street, address_city, address_zip), permit_id/permit_number, permit_status, is_roofing, days_open, applied/issued/approved/completed dates (permits.* date columns), contractor_name, and the permit source/jurisdiction. Evidence: results will come from the permits view (permit rows) joined to properties (for parcel and address); Clermont contractor names come from Clermont eTRAKiT captures in this run. Note: BBB ratings are gated (HTTP 403) in this dataset and cannot be returned. Confirm the days threshold and I’ll run the query.

limitations: Current/open roofing permit status, duration and legal identity remain unaccepted.
Built year is a low-confidence roof-age proxy, not measured roof age.
Ten-year ownership tenure and BBB scores are not established.
Independent retention and later incremental IPFS promotion remain held.
failureReason: Observed model-supplied sample identifier and address have no corresponding selected-dataset record; open-permit prompt promises unsupported filtering.
